neet_phy_u18_t08_1.working: Cadmium and boron have large neutron-absorption cross-sections. Control rods made of them absorb excess neutrons and so regulate the chain reaction. Slowing neutrons is the moderator's job.

neet_phy_u18_t08_2.working: Energy per fission = 200e6 × 1.6e-19 = 3.2e-11 J. Fissions per second = 3.2e6 / 3.2e-11 = 1e17.

neet_phy_u18_t08_3.working: Nucleons taking part = 2 + 3 = 5. Energy per nucleon = 17.6 / 5 = 3.52 MeV.

neet_phy_u18_t08_4.working: A is true: fusion is called thermonuclear because it needs very high temperatures to overcome Coulomb repulsion. R is also true, but it does not explain the name.

neet_phy_u18_t08_5.working: Mass numbers: 235 + 1 = 140 + 94 + x, so x = 2; charge balances (92 = 54 + 38). I is correct. Withdrawing control rods means fewer neutrons are absorbed, so K > 1 and the reactor is supercritical. II is correct.
